title: UPESSC Principal Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission
postName: Principal (Secondary / Higher Secondary institutions as notified)
vacancyDetails: Principal posts in UP government aided / secondary education institutions under UPESSC
qualification: Post Graduate + B.Ed. with prescribed teaching and administrative experience as per UPESSC Principal rules
selectionProcess: Written Exam / Interview as per commission scheme → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit official UPESSC website
2. Open Principal recruitment apply online
3. Register and fill educational & experience details
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Submit application printout
shortDescription: UPESSC Principal Online Form 2026 – apply for Principal posts in Uttar Pradesh education institutions.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) conducts recruitment for Principal posts in the state education system.

Eligible candidates with PG, B.Ed. and required experience should apply on the official UPESSC portal and follow the selection schedule published in the advertisement.
